units.title: SG-8.3 Submit button disabled and loading states with inline success feedback
Act: Add submitting state and full disabled computation to ContributionSheet Send
Act: Show the 'Sending…' loading label on the Send button
Act: Render inline success message after a successful send
Verify: Send disabled for blank, over-limit, zero-quota and in-flight unit tests

tests.id: contributionSubmitDisabled > blank text and no history
tests.name: Send is disabled when the idea is blank and the player has no history
tests.title: ContributionSheet Send disabled states: Send is disabled when the idea is blank and the player has no history
tests.scenario: Given listMine resolves [] and no text, When the sheet renders, Then Send is disabled

tests.name: Send is disabled when the idea is whitespace only
tests.title: ContributionSheet Send disabled states: Send is disabled when the idea is whitespace only
tests.scenario: Given the idea is '   ', When typed, Then Send is disabled

tests.name: Send is disabled when the idea is one character over MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH
tests.title: ContributionSheet Send disabled states: Send is disabled when the idea is one character over MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH
tests.scenario: Given 501 'x' characters, When typed, Then Send is disabled

tests.name: Send is disabled at zero quota even with a valid idea
tests.title: ContributionSheet Send disabled states: Send is disabled at zero quota even with a valid idea
tests.scenario: Given listMine returns MAX_PER_PLAYER contributions, When a valid idea is typed, Then Send is disabled

tests.name: Send is disabled while a submission is in flight
tests.title: ContributionSheet Send disabled states: Send is disabled while a submission is in flight
tests.scenario: Given submitContribution never resolves, When a valid idea is submitted, Then Send is disabled and aria-busy is true

tests.name: Send is enabled for a valid idea when quota remains
tests.title: ContributionSheet Send disabled states: Send is enabled for a valid idea when quota remains
tests.scenario: Given listMine resolves [] and a valid idea, When typed, Then Send is enabled

tests.name: contributionBlank.test.tsx blank submit tests
tests.title: ContributionSheet blank submit: blank and whitespace submits show 'Enter an idea first' without submitting
tests.scenario: Given Send is disabled for blank text, When the form is submitted, Then the inline message shows and submitContribution is not called

tests.name: contributionMaxLength.test.tsx over-limit tests
tests.title: ContributionSheet over limit: 501 characters show the limit message and block submit
tests.scenario: Given 501 characters, When the form is submitted, Then 'Too long: 501 / 500' shows and submitContribution is not called

units.title: Verify: Send loading label unit tests

tests.id: contributionLoadingLabel.test.tsx > shows the Sending… label with aria-busy while the submit is in flight, then returns to Send on success
tests.name: shows the Sending… label with aria-busy while the submit is in flight, then returns to Send on success
tests.title: shows the Sending… label with aria-busy while the submit is in flight, then returns to Send on success
tests.scenario: Given the sheet is open and submitContribution returns a pending promise, When the form is submitted with 'hello', Then the button reads 'Sending…' with aria-busy="true"; When the promise resolves, Then the button reads 'Send' again.

tests.id: contributionLoadingLabel.test.tsx > returns the button label to Send when the submit is rejected
tests.name: returns the button label to Send when the submit is rejected
tests.title: returns the button label to Send when the submit is rejected
tests.scenario: Given submitContribution rejects with an Error, When the form is submitted, Then the button label returns to 'Send' and 'Sending…' is no longer shown.

units.title: Verify: Inline success and error feedback unit tests

tests.id: contributionSuccessFeedback.test.tsx > success sends status without alert
tests.name: Given a successful send, when the idea is submitted, then it shows the success status and no alert
tests.title: shows 'Suggestion sent' in a status region and no alert after a successful send
tests.scenario: Given submitContribution resolves, when the player sends 'hello', then role=status reads 'Suggestion sent' and role=alert is absent

tests.name: Given the server answers 429, when the idea is submitted, then it shows the slow-down alert and no status
tests.title: shows the slow-down alert and no status region when the server answers 429
tests.scenario: Given submitContribution rejects with ApiError 429, when the player sends, then role=alert reads 'Slow down, try again shortly' and role=status is absent

tests.name: Given a successful send, when the player edits the idea, then the success status is cleared
tests.title: clears the success status once the player edits the idea again
tests.scenario: Given a successful send shows the status, when the player changes the textarea to 'more', then role=status is absent

units.title: REQ · Send is disabled when text is blank, over limit, quota is exhausted or a send is in flight
REQ · Send shows a loading label while the submission is in flight
REQ · Inline success feedback is shown after a successful send alongside the existing error feedback
Evidence: Submit button states and inline feedback unit tests
